tasks.gr7-revision-all-genres-t4: Topic: Revision of all genres. Integrate novel, poetry, drama, media texts, and comprehension strategies. Ask Grade 7 learners to identify genre features, retrieve evidence, make supported inferences, and recognise concise, accurate summaries.
tasks.gr7-exam-writing-practice-t4: Topic: Exam writing practice. Cover essay types, transactional texts, planning, editing, and timing. Ask Grade 7 learners to choose suitable structures under pressure, match tone to audience, and identify common exam-writing improvements.
tasks.gr7-grammar-consolidation-t4: Topic: Grammar consolidation. Cover tenses, clauses, punctuation, vocabulary, and language in context. Ask Grade 7 learners to correct sentence errors, maintain tense consistency, and apply language conventions in exam-style scenarios.
